answer.origin: finance.yahoo.com article dated 2026-07-01 reporting NN, Inc.'s late-June 2026 announcement (original NN press release not in the record; original_day not supplied). Source tier fact for the expansion claim; the 100% pre-sold status and the US$80-90 million 2026 target are company statements as reported; the 2028 revenue and earnings figures are third-party narrative and analyst projections.
answer.note: Covered company is NVDA. NN, Inc. reportedly announced in late June 2026 that it would add 47 machine centers at its Wuxi, China plant for liquid cooling production for NVIDIA AI data center racks, and that 100% of the new capacity was already pre-sold under multi-year, multi-product awards. This is a supplier-side signal: it suggests NVIDIA's AI rack ecosystem is pulling forward liquid cooling capacity in Asia, which is relevant to NVIDIA's supply chain and rack-level demand. It does not show that NVIDIA is the direct buyer of these awards, nor does it give NVIDIA order volumes or revenue. The company's targeted US$80-90 million of accretive new business in 2026 is a supplier target, not NVIDIA data, and it cannot be treated as NVIDIA purchasing. Conditional interpretation: if the awards trace to NVIDIA rack programs, the item supports continued rack-scale AI build-out and dependence on third-party thermal suppliers; if they are for other data center customers, it supports only general AI data center demand. The Russell Microcap Value Index removal and the 2028 projections concern NN's own equity and financial outlook and do not bear on NVDA.
limitations: No disclosed customer identity or contract terms for the 47 machine centers or the multi-year awards, so the NVIDIA link rests on the article's framing rather than a named purchase relationship.
The US$80-90 million target has no disclosed assumptions, timing split, or confirmation of how much derives from NVIDIA-linked racks.
No NVIDIA-side confirmation, filing, or statement in the record that NVIDIA sources liquid cooling from NN or that NVIDIA has committed volumes.
The 2028 revenue and earnings figures come from an unnamed narrative and unnamed analysts; they are not NN or NVDA guidance and carry low evidential weight for NVDA.
The original NN announcement date within late June 2026 and the primary press release are not in the record.
follow_up: Retrieve NN's original late-June 2026 press release or 8-K and check whether it names NVIDIA or any rack OEM as the customer for the new Wuxi capacity.
Check NVIDIA's most recent 10-K and supplier disclosures for any named NN, Inc. relationship or thermal-supplier concentration language.
Check NN's next quarterly earnings call or filing for the timing and customer split of the US$80-90 million 2026 target.
Check whether any export-control or China-manufacturing restriction applies to liquid cooling products shipped for NVIDIA racks from the Wuxi plant.
